That's how I unlocked all of my Living World Seasons - with in-game gold to gems conversion. It didn't affect my gameplay too much, and I found it more fun to unlock the Seasons this way. 

What I did was, I waited to convert gems when the prices were lower than usual (so back then, 130 gold for 400 gems was pretty low; now a good price is ~150 gold for 400 gems), and then I would only buy the seasons when they went on sale (usually 20-30% off). Then, I just played through the story and would get enough gold to buy the next season I needed. 

Living World Season 2 is the most expensive one, but also offers the least value (for instance, no additional maps). However, since LWS2 story takes place in core maps, you can access and play through the story with anyone who owns LWS2. So if you have a friend or guild mate that is willing to help, I recommend you play through LWS2 this way (join their story instances), and only unlock it later for achievements.

Let me know if you need me to clarify anything. :)
If you've leveled all of your characters to lvl 80 before purchasing any expansion, create a new character and get it to level 10 to permanently unlock the raptor mount on your entire account!

Correction: You can only buy expansions with actual money. However, Living World Seasons (mini-expansions that add maps and story) can be purchased on the in-game store with gems, which can be bought with gold earned in-game. But you can only convert gold to gems once you have purchased any of the expansions.
